system.description: The Bruid begins to sing a beautiful song about heroic actions and magnificent destinies in the future. This song has a healing effect on the Bruid and all allies who are within range and listening to the song. They are healed for 2 Body Points per minute for the duration of the ability. This song can heal a maximum of 10 Body Points per person per day.
